verseGurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਤੁਮ ਭੇਜੇ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਬੁਲਾਏ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਆਉ ॥
verseTranslation: The One who sent you, has now recalled you; return to your home now in peace and pleasure.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਤੁਮ ਭੇਜੇ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਬੁਲਾਏ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਆਉ ॥
verses.translation: The One who sent you, has now recalled you; return to your home now in peace and pleasure.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਰਾਜੁ ਕਮਾਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translation: In bliss and ecstasy, sing His Glorious Praises; by this celestial tune, you shall acquire your everlasting kingdom. ||1||
Come back to your home, O my friend.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ਅਪਦਾ ਭਈ ਬਿਤੀਤ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translation: The Lord Himself has eliminated your enemies, and your misfortunes are past. ||Pause||

verses.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਕੀਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਨੇਹਾਰੇ ਨਾਸਨ ਭਾਜਨ ਥਾਕੇ ॥
verses.translation: God, the Creator Lord, has glorified you, and your running and rushing around has ended.

verses.gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਮੰਗਲ ਵਾਜਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਵਾਜੇ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਖਸਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਜੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translation: In your home, there is rejoicing; the musical instruments continually play, and your Husband Lord has exalted you. ||2||

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਸਥਿਰ ਰਹਹੁ ਡੋਲਹੁ ਮਤ ਕਬਹੂ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਅਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translation: Remain firm and steady, and do not ever waver; take the Guru's Word as your Support.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਸਗਲ ਭੂ ਮੰਡਲ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਦਰਬਾਰ ॥੩॥
verses.translation: You shall be applauded and congratulated all over the world, and your face shall be radiant in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਤਿਨੈ ਹੀ ਫੇਰੇ ਆਪੇ ਭਇਆ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
verses.translation: All beings belong to Him; He Himself transforms them, and He Himself becomes their help and support.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਚਰਜੁ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੪॥੪॥੨੮॥
verses.translation: The Creator Lord has worked a wondrous miracle; O Nanak, His glorious greatness is true. ||4||4||28||
